content.title: Accessory Dwelling Units (ADU) Building Permit
content.summary: An Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) is an additional housing unit within or on the same lot as a single-family home, with separate entries and amenities. The City of Arvada categorizes ADUs into Type A (detached) and Type B (attached or inside the home) and requires permits issued only to licensed contractors.
content.eligibility: Permits are only issued to Licensed Contractors with a type 1B, 2B or 3B license.

steps.title: Review Requirements
steps.text: Review the list of required documents and steps before beginning the application process. Understand the types of ADUs and zoning requirements applicable to your property.

steps.title: Prepare Documentation
steps.text: Prepare all required plans and documents including architectural plans, structural plans stamped by a licensed professional, plot plans, grading plans, utility plans, and other required calculations and reports depending on ADU type.

steps.title: Apply Online
steps.text: Login to the Arvada Permits system and submit your application using the SMART License & Permits Online Application. Upload all required PDF plans and related documents.

steps.title: Wait for Review
steps.text: The City of Arvada will review your application. Type A ADUs typically take 3 weeks, and Type B ADUs take 1 to 2 weeks for review.

steps.title: Obtain Approval and Begin Construction
steps.text: Once approved, ensure all subcontractors are listed on the permit to avoid holds. Begin construction following all permit conditions and inspections.

required_documents.name: Architectural Plans
required_documents.description: Floor plans, elevations, cross sections, and electrical plans showing the design of the ADU.

required_documents.name: Plot Plan
required_documents.description: Details size, setbacks, lot coverage, landscaping, and parking for the property.

required_documents.name: Grading Plan
required_documents.description: Plan showing grading details for the site.

required_documents.name: Utility Plan
required_documents.description: Plan showing utility connections for water, sewer, gas, and electrical.

required_documents.name: Structural Plans
required_documents.description: Foundation and structural plans stamped and signed by a licensed engineer or architect in Colorado.

required_documents.name: Truss Specification Package
required_documents.description: Stamped and signed by a licensed engineer.

required_documents.name: Soils Report
required_documents.description: Stamped and signed by a licensed engineer.

required_documents.name: Manual J, D, and S Calculations
required_documents.description: Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning load calculations.

required_documents.name: RESCheck or HERS Rating Calculations
required_documents.description: Energy performance calculations if the performance energy path is utilized.

required_documents.name: Approved 1 Hour Fire Separation Detail with STC Rating
required_documents.description: Required for Type B ADUs, showing fire separation and sound transmission class rating of 45 or greater.

required_documents.name: Gas Line Calculations
required_documents.description: May be requested depending on the project.

form_fields.label: Type of ADU
form_fields.description: Select whether the ADU is Type A (detached) or Type B (attached or inside the home).
form_fields.why_needed: Determines applicable requirements and review timelines.

form_fields.label: Contractor License Type
form_fields.description: Specify the contractor's license type (1B, 2B, or 3B) to ensure eligibility for permit issuance.
form_fields.why_needed: Permits are only issued to licensed contractors with these license types.

form_fields.label: Property Address
form_fields.description: The address where the ADU will be constructed.
form_fields.why_needed: To verify zoning and property eligibility.

form_fields.label: Upload Plans and Documents
form_fields.description: Upload all required PDF plans and supporting documents for review.
form_fields.why_needed: Required for plan review and permit approval.

timelines.review: Type A: 3 weeks; Type B: 1 to 2 weeks
